title: Preserve headless and automation compatibility
purpose: Ensure making AgentOS TUI-oriented does not break noninteractive release gates, support workflows or automation.
scope: Verify scripted TUI replay works without terminal control sequences.
Verify release, functional replay and ecosystem replay remain headless.
Document mode selection between default TUI console and automation.
Add tests for no-tty or CI environments.
acceptance_criteria: Headless commands do not try to open an interactive TUI.
Automation mode produces deterministic output and exit codes.
Release gate can run on CI without a TTY.
TUI-oriented default is packaged but overridable.
failure_modes: Release scripts hang waiting for interactive input.
TUI default disables operator projection automation.
Scripted mode emits nondeterministic terminal control output.
